newsitem.title: UK: TVX pulls offer for Active Imaging.
newsitem.headline: TVX pulls offer for Active Imaging.

text.p: TVX Inc, a subsidiary of CommNet Cellular Inc, said on Thursday that it was withdrawing its offer for Britain's Active Imaging Plc after a planned initial public offering (IPO) of its shares was cancelled due to adverse stock market conditions.

In a statement, TVX said it proposed to continue exploring ways with Active Imaging in which the two companies could "take advantage of the strong complementary nature of their product offerings and technological skills".
TVX made a recommended offer for Active Imaging in February valuing its shares at a minimum of 104 pence.
The offer valued Active Imaging's ordinary share capital at around 19.1 million stg.

Colorado-based TVX, which develops and markets products for the management of digital video and images, has irrevocable undertakings to accept the offer from holders of 77.5 percent of Active Imaging's ordinary shareholders.
Active Imaging shares closed on Thursday at 87-1/2 pence per share. -- London Newsroom +44171 542 7717
